headline: Approved resolution authorizing mayor to execute DEEP grant agreement for purchase of 138 Williams Road, 9-0.
summary: The Town Council met in executive session to discuss the purchase of property for the Law Department. The Council then approved a resolution authorizing the Mayor to execute a DEEP grant agreement for the purchase of 138 Williams Road, which was purchased and paid for by the Water Division using a $435,500 grant from DEEP.
decisions: Approved resolution authorizing the Mayor to execute DEEP grant agreement for receipt of grant for purchase of 138 Williams Road, roll call vote 9-0.
